name: Marvelous Mandragoras
desc: Under the influence of pure kuuvahki energy, these wondrous plant-like creatures have emerged after a long period of evolution, possessing the ability to move independently.

imgDesc.text: Under the influence of pure kuuvahki energy, these wondrous plant-like creatures have emerged after a long period of evolution, possessing the ability to move independently.

After they absorb kuuvahki energy and become
Suffused, you can take advantage of this state to
charge objects that are susceptible to kuuvahki, or
purify objects affected by the Abyss.
